messages:
amanda: Quick sync request from CloudX 1: they want a co-hosted webinar tied to their marketplace entry. Scope: webinar + co-post + short integration spotlight. Can we run dates and owners?

jess: I can do the live demo. Need a CloudX sandbox account and a small dataset with predictable prompts.

mike: I'll take landing + blog + social. Can we decide headline + CTA now so I can start wireframing?

sam: For lead routing: Marketo -> webhook -> lead lambda -> SFDC. Suggest tagging MQL if registrant requests demo or lead_score >= 50, then assign to Partnerships queue by geo.

elaine: Add UTMs: utm_source=cloudx, utm_medium=partner, utm_campaign=cloudx-cohost. Also capture marketplace_referral_id hidden field.

amanda: Proposed date: Wed Jun 12. Three weeks prep. Deliverables: landing (mike), blog draft (mike), demo script + screenshots (jess), benchmark slide (elaine), speaker bios (amanda).

mike: I'll upload a draft landing by Friday. Need 3 screenshots by Thu AM.

jess: I'll grab screenshots Thu morning. Sample smoke command for partner to validate sandbox access:

jess: ```bash
# smoke test
curl -X POST https://sandbox.cloudx.example/api/v1/connect -H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>" -d '{"workspace":"redwood-demo","sample":"hello world"}'
```

amanda: DMing CloudX for creds today and asking them to mirror our demo workspace.

sam: SFDC mapping: Company=partner_account, LeadSource="CloudX Marketplace", CampaignId=CloudX_Cohost_Jun12. If no owner, assign to Partnerships queue.

elaine: For the benchmark narrative, keep it readable: p95 latency, cost/1k tokens, throughput. I'll mock figures and loop in infra for validation.

mike: Social plan: 1) joint blog w/partner quotes, 2) 30s demo clip for LinkedIn, 3) update marketplace listing to push webinar. Partner review window: 48 hours.

amanda: Ask partner to review assets by Tue May 30 so we stay on schedule. Also want a replay landing page that captures leads + trial opt-in.

jess: Tech run: 30min with partner + 15min internal. Checklist: network egress, token scopes, screen share, demo data reset.

ops-bot: Reminder: record webinar and upload to s3://redwood-marketing/webinars/cloudx-jun12/; retention 90d.

sam: Post-webinar nurture: Day0 thank-you (co-branded), Day2 on-demand + demo guide, Day7 case study + trial CTA. Tag leads with "cloudx_cohost" campaign.

mike: Drafted subject lines: A) "See Redwood + CloudX: faster LLM inference" B) "How CloudX users cut latency for LLM features" C) "Live demo: Redwood & CloudX integration" 1: which resonates?

amanda: A is my pick. Value-first.

elaine: Goals: Registrations >= 350, Attendee rate >= 30%, MQLs >= 50, Trials >= 20. Let's baseline with last quarter partner webinar.

growth-bot: Growth action: provide two pre-built prompts + one eval prompt for demo consistency. ETA Tue.

jess: Great 1 I'll design demo examples to produce stable outputs.

mike: I'll include UTMs and a hidden marketplace_partner_id on form. Also add referral_id to lead payload for reconciliation.

amanda: Summary of owners: Amanda = partner ops + approval; Jess = demo + rehearsal; Mike = landing/blog/social; Sam = routing & SFDC; Elaine = benchmarks & slides. Ops-bot = record config. Next sync Tue May 30 10am PT (15m).

ops-bot: Calendar invite sent: Tue May 30 10:00 PT.

amanda: Thx team 1 I'll update project board and ping when CloudX sandbox creds are live. :rocket:
